Gate render/constraints each have 1 binary criterion with all_pass. Scored functional has 43 binary criteria, polish 5 binary and visual 5 likert with points=5, all weighted_mean. Criterion ids are unique per file. [judge] keys are only isolated/judge/mcp_servers/mode/prompt_template/timeout, and every prompt.md has one {criteria} and one {app_context}. Shell: `bash -n` passes for solution/solve.sh and tests/test.sh, both start with #!/bin/bash. The app-restart.sh heredoc in test.sh also passes `bash -n`, and its three embedded python heredocs pass ast.parse. A byte scan finds no CR in any task file, and no TOML file has a BOM. Python: tests/tools/score.py and restart_mcp.py pass ast.parse. JSON: both seed_data.json files parse and are byte-identical; package.json parses (commonjs, main server.js, express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1 pinned, matching the global installs in both Dockerfiles). Entry: `node --check` (v24.19.0 local) passes for server.js, src/{index,bootstrap,db}.js and public/js/{board,threads,app}.js. The browser loads these as classic scripts (index.html:31-33), and they contain no top-level import/export. server.js requires ./src/index.js; all requires are builtins, local files or express/better-sqlite3. Template: tests/test.sh, tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py, tests/Dockerfile, .dockerignore and environment/Dockerfile are byte-identical to rules/projects/webdev-task-template. Budgets nest: gate judges 600+600 < 1500, scored 9000+900+900 < 11100, and 1500+11100 < 13200. Runtime: raw-evidence-index.json artifact hashes and matching_source_files hashes all verify against current bytes. results/workspace.json shows 25/25 scripted golden groups passed with page_errors [], including a real restart, and server.log shows '[hireops] listening on 3000'. That proves the reference entry runs, but it was not a test.sh or configured judge run. The index scope says a full configured grading run is absent; that gap belongs to the runtime rows, not to this well-formedness row. Adversarial: (a) a broken app that parses still passes this row by design, since behaviour is graded by other rows. (b) A conforming ESM or alternative-entry app is not refused by these files; test.sh only requires /app/server.js, which instruction/test.sh fix. No parser or line-ending defect found.
